statement: Key lifecycle discipline for every Council of AI signing identity. Append-only: a rotation adds a key and closes the old one's validity; nothing is deleted; a compromise is recorded in the revocation register, never silently swapped.

keys.rotation: on schedule or on incident; successor announced in this file before first use
on schedule or on incident; successor announced in this file before first use
on schedule or on incident; successor announced in this file before first use
on schedule or on incident; successor announced in this file before first use

keys.scope: COSE_Sign1 interop expressions of measurement cards ONLY. Explicitly NOT a board-, card- or chain-attestation root; nothing on the GSPC board is signed with it.
keys.did_anchoring: pending owner commit to did.json (trust-root changes are owner-gated by policy; this file may announce a key before the DID doc carries it, never the reverse for root keys)

rotation_policy.trigger: scheduled rotation, scope change, or suspected compromise
rotation_policy.procedure: new kid announced here with scope + created date -> anchored in did.json by owner commit -> old kid marked status=retired with validUntil -> retired keys remain listed forever so old signatures stay verifiable
rotation_policy.incident_vs_rotation: a rotation is planned and leaves the old key valid-until-date; a revocation is an incident and voids trust from the stated compromise time (JB-D1 ruling pending owner word)

revocation_register.statement: empty at publication - an empty register is honest; this file is the place a stranger checks
